revisions.description: Takes the first value from the file content returned by a valid JSONPath expression and sets as an output property

changelog.reason: Query is required, as the task always needed; File Path is absolute or relative to /workspace; a query that matches nothing sets an empty evaluation with a warning, and the value is no longer logged

params.label: File Path
params.helpertext: A workspace file holding JSON, absolute or relative to /workspace
params.name: filePath

params.label: Query Expression
params.helpertext: A JSONPath expression, e.g. $.items[0].id. One that matches nothing sets an empty evaluation
params.name: query

results.description: The value the query matched, JSON for an object or array; empty when nothing matched
results.name: evaluation
